I’ve heard from Minnesotans and local newspapers about how a new Trump mail delivery plan from the U.S. Postal Service will negatively impact them — making it slower and less reliable.

That's your paycheck, Social Security benefits, medications and news.

I'm urging the USPS to reverse this plan.
